difficulty_reason: Prove Cohstack_{X/B} -> Cohstack_{Y/B} is a closed immersion for a closed immersion pi: X -> Y: the pi_* equivalence identifies objects of the source with Cohstack_{Y/B} objects annihilated by the ideal I_T (after any base change, I_T the image ideal sheaf); analyzing lemma-coherent-functorial the essential image is exactly the objects with vanishing multiplication map F tensor (Y_T -> Y)^*I -> F; the displayed base-change identity for the tensor shows the vanishing condition is stable under further base change, so by the F-zero-closed lemma it is represented by a closed subspace of T.
